subject: Fix cluster slot stats for scripts with cross-slot keys (#2835)

findings.detail: variant-mismatch: command 6 (CLUSTER SLOT-STATS SLOTSRANGE 5061 5061) replies otherwise with resp 3: {"reply":[[5061,{"cpu-usec":55,"key-count":2,"network-bytes-in":249,"network-bytes-out":31}]]}, not {"reply":[[5061,["key-count",2,"cpu-usec",60,"network-bytes-in",249,"network-bytes-out",31]]]}

variant-mismatch: command 3 (CLUSTER SLOT-STATS SLOTSRANGE 5061 5061) replies otherwise with resp 2: {"reply":[[5061,["key-count",2,"cpu-usec",49,"network-bytes-in",120,"network-bytes-out",18]]]}, not {"reply":[[5061,{"cpu-usec":36,"key-count":2,"network-bytes-in":120,"network-bytes-out":18}]]}
